Tidy summaries of a fitted model

Source: R/tables.R
tidy.regcomp_fit.Rd

Methods for the generics tidy(), glance() and augment() of the generics package (also used by broom, modelsummary and gtsummary). tidy() returns one row per coefficient with the distribution parameter it belongs to (component), and one row per random effect variance parameter (effect = "ran_pars"). Random effect standard deviations are reported on their natural scale (sd(...)). For Bayesian fits the estimate is the posterior mean, std.error the posterior standard deviation, the interval a credible interval, and rhat and ess are added.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'regcomp_fit'
tidy(
  x,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.level = 0.95,
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  vcov = "model",
  standardize = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'regcomp_fit'
glance(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'regcomp_fit'
augment(x, data = NULL, newdata = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted model from regcomp().

conf.int

Add confidence (credible) intervals.

conf.level

Interval level.

exponentiate

Exponentiate coefficients and their intervals (odds ratios, rate ratios); random effect parameters are not changed.

vcov

"model", "sandwich" or "quasi" standard errors (see summary.regcomp_fit()).

standardize

Multiply each coefficient (and its interval) by the standard deviation of its design column: the change of the linear predictor per standard deviation of the covariate (partially standardized coefficients; meaningful for any family, unlike scaling the response). Applied before exponentiate.

...

Unused.

data, newdata

For augment(): data to add columns to; defaults to the analysis rows of the fit.

Value

A data frame.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(100)); d$y <- rpois(100, exp(0.5 + 0.3 * d$x))
f <- regcomp(y ~ x, family = "poisson", data = d)
if (requireNamespace("generics", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(generics::tidy(f, exponentiate = TRUE))
  print(generics::glance(f))
}
#>          term component effect estimate std.error statistic      p.value
#> 1 (Intercept)    lambda  fixed 1.712853 0.1359888  6.778428 1.214909e-11
#> 2           x    lambda  fixed 1.466126 0.1162242  4.826659 1.388424e-06
#>   conf.low conf.high
#> 1 1.466023  2.001243
#> 2 1.255146  1.712571
#>    family engine nobs df    logLik      AIC      BIC converged
#> 1 Poisson     ml  100  2 -160.1507 324.3014 329.5118      TRUE
